var(--color-accent-dark);border-bottom:3px double var(--color-accent-dark);padding:0.3rem 0.6rem;display:inline-block;max-width:100%;}.nav-list{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-sm);margin:0;padding:0;}.nav-list a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--color-text);font-weight:bold;padding:0.5rem 0.25rem;}.nav-list a:hover{color:var(--color-accent-dark);text-decoration:underline;}footer{background-color:var(--color-accent-dark);color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);padding:var(--space-md) 0;margin-top:var(--space-lg);}footer p{margin:0.25rem 0;color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}.footer-brand{font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:0.05em;}.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;padding:0.75rem 1.5rem;background-color:var(--color-accent-dark);color:#ffffff;border:none;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:1rem;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;}.btn:hover{background-color:#122c52;}.btn-secondary{background-color:transparent;color:var(--color-accent-dark);border:2px 0;}.section-alt{background-color:var(--color-bg-alt);}label{display:block;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.25rem;}input,textarea,select{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:0.5rem 0.75rem;border:1px (max-width:600px){.header-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}.nav-list{flex-direction:column;gap:0.25rem;width:100%;}.container{padding:0 1rem;}.section{padding:var(--space-md) 0;}}@media (min-width:601px){.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}.grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.header-inner{flex-wrap:nowrap;}}

pages.html:
APEX BUSINESS SOLUTIONS
  • Services
  • Why Us
  • Testimonials
  • Contact

Practical Business Solutions, Clear Pricing

Apex Business Solutions helps small and growing companies in Riverton handle the bookkeeping, consulting, and administrative work that keeps a business running smoothly — with no hidden fees and no surprises.

View Our Services Get In Touch

Our Services

Three focused service packages, each designed to give you professional support without overextending your budget.

Bookkeeping & Payroll

$249/month

Monthly reconciliation, payroll processing for up to 10 employees, and a clear financial summary delivered every month.

  • Bank & credit card reconciliation
  • Payroll & tax filing support
  • Monthly financial statements
Request This Service

Business Consulting

$125/hour

One-on-one strategy sessions covering growth planning, cash flow management, and operational efficiency.

  • Growth & strategy planning
  • Cash flow & budgeting review
  • Operations assessment
Request This Service

Administrative Support

$799/month

A dedicated virtual assistant for scheduling, correspondence, invoicing, and day-to-day office tasks.

  • Up to 40 hours per month
  • Invoicing & client correspondence
  • Calendar & inbox management
Request This Service

Why Choose Apex

Transparent Pricing

No hourly surprises or buried fees. You know exactly what you'll pay before work begins.

Local & Responsive

Based right here in Riverton, we answer calls and emails promptly and meet with clients in person.

Experienced Team

Over 15 years of combined experience supporting small businesses across finance, strategy, and operations.

What Clients Say

"Apex took over our bookkeeping and payroll within a week, and our monthly reports have never been clearer. Worth every dollar."

— Marcus Webb, Owner, Webb Hardware Supply

"The consulting sessions helped us restructure our pricing and cash flow. We saw a real improvement within two months."

— Priya Anand, Founder, Anand Design Studio
